facts.fact: On 24 September 2024 the Secretary-General of the Ministry of National Education closed pupil enrolment on X-Gest after irregularities in enrolments and re-enrolments for 2024-2025, and ordered as a precaution that no personal data, school results included, pass through the platform, AGP reports.

The ministry's note of 24 September 2024 states that pupils' enrolments and re-enrolments had been carried out on the X-Gest platform since the start of school year 2024-2025, until the ministry closed them that day; it does not say who made the entries.

systems.owner: not stated; the ministry orders its use stopped
systems.tiers: pupil enrolment and re-enrolment and school results, levels not stated

note: A withdrawal: the kept fact records what ran on the platform up to 24 September 2024, the day the ministry barred it; no count of schools is given.
